definition: ὑπωπιάζω (ὑπώπιον, (a) the part of the face below the eyes; (b) a blow on the face), to strike under the eye, give a black eye:  metaphorically,  __(a) of persistent annoyance (RV, wear out), Luk.18:6;  __(b) of severe self-discipline (R, txt. buffet, mg. bruise), 1Co.9:27 (see Field, Notes, 71, 174).† ὑπο-πιάζω,  later form of ὑποπιέζω, to press slightly; metaphorically,  to repress: 1Co.9:27 T.7 for ὑπωπιάζω, which see† (AS)
